facts.fact: The IPPIS Human Resource modules, covering payroll administration, serve over 508 federal MDAs and over 600,000 civil servants, per the Head of the Civil Service.
The IPPIS HR modules went live on 27 July 2026 on the locally developed SoftSuite platform, a migration from foreign software.

systems.country_label: Integrated Personnel and Payroll Information System
systems.platform: SoftSuite Human Capital Management (Soft Alliance and Resources)
systems.owner: Office of the Head of the Civil Service of the Federation
